name: stock_ops
summary: Operation task board, putaway suggestions, wave picking and barcode scan verification
description: Work-level task records for receive, inspect, putaway, pick, pack, count and return work; capacity- and priority-aware putaway location suggestions with operator override; wave planning that generates consolidated pick tasks across transfer orders; a barcode scan log that blocks completion on mismatch (blueprint sections 3.3, 5.4, 16).
author: Nexa
